listings.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
listings.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

listings.description: Leiter Finanzen & Controlling (m/w/d) Die Sicon Industrie- und Gewerbebau GmbH & Co. KG ist ein expandierendes Unternehmen im Bereich Industriehallen- und Gewerbebau. Gemeinsam mit weiteren Gesellschaften und unterschiedlichen Geschäftsbereichen bilden wir eine vielseitig aufgestellte Unternehmensgruppe. Neben unserem operativen Baugeschäft gehören unter anderem Immobilien- und Vermietungsobjekte, Photovoltaikanlagen sowie weitere Investitionen und Beteiligungen zu unseren wirtschaftlichen Aktivitäten. Um die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung unserer verschiedenen Gesellschaften und Geschäftsbereiche noch transparenter und effizienter steuern zu können, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten und erfahrenen Leiter Finanzen & Controlling (m/w/d) Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis, denkst unternehmerisch und möchtest nicht nur Zahlen verwalten, sondern wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge erkennen und aktiv mitgestalten? listings.description:

Als Senior Category Manager trägst du die Verantwortung für mehrere Kategorien und bist maßgeblich verantwortlich für die strategische Weiterentwicklung. listings.title: Praktikum Business Analytics (m/w/d)
listings.description:
Kurz und knapp 

Als Business Analyst Intern bei Picnic bist du an vorderster Front der Innovation und stellst dich komplexen Herausforderungen mit bahnbrechenden Lösungen. Diese Rolle dreht sich um Innovation – du analysierst Daten, unterstützt Chancen zu identifizieren und Strategien zu entwickeln, die Grenzen überschreiten und das Einkaufserlebnis zu revolutionieren. Während deines Praktikums arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Analyst:innen zusammen, erhältst Mentoring und entwickelst die Fähigkeiten, um optimal für eine mögliche Vollzeitstelle als Business Analyst bei uns vorbereitet zu sein.

Dort bringst du dich ein 

  • Logistik – Optimiere das Rückgrat unserer Prozesse – von den Fulfillment-Centern über die Zustellung unserer last-mile bis hin zur Nachfrageprognose in ganz Europa. Think: Automatisierung internationaler Lieferprognosen für Wachstumsmärkte wie München.

  • Consumer – Treibe das Wachstum durch Preisgestaltung, effektive Lieferantenbeziehungen und unsere Marktstrategie voran. Think: Mitgestaltung unseres erfolgreichen Markteintritts in neue Städte. Deine Entscheidungen prägen das Einkaufserlebnis von Millionen von Kundinnen und Kunden bei Picnic.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Löse echte Herausforderungen: Stelle dich kritischen Geschäftsfragen, die das Geschäftsmodell von Picnic täglich prägen. Neugierig auf die Fragen?

  • Ermögliche: Erreiche operative Exzellenz, indem du Herausforderungen mit einem datengetriebenen und analytischen Ansatz meisterst

  • Entwickle: Erstelle und optimiere Modelle für Verbesserungen in Echtzeit

  • Kommuniziere: Arbeite effe

listings.title: Commercial Analytics Werkstudent (m/w/d)
listings.description:
Kurz und knapp

Bei Picnic basiert unser gesamtes Geschäftsmodell auf Daten. Für unser Team suchen wir analytische und neugierige Köpfe als Commercial Analytics Working Student.

Du wirst Teil der Teams, die unseren digitalen Supermarkt am Laufen halten. Du tauchst tief in Datensätze ein, um unsere Preise zu optimieren, unser Sortiment zu verbessern, Kampagnen zu analysieren und genau die Insights zu finden, die unser Wachstum vorantreiben.

Das erwartet dich

Je nach deinem genauen Fokusbereich können folgende Aufgaben zu deinem Tag gehören:

  • Data Deep-Dives: Nutze SQL, Python oder Excel, um Kundentrends zu entschlüsseln, unsere Marktpositionierung zu analysieren und neue Wachstumschancen aufzudecken.
  • Kommerzielle Strategie: Analysiere die Produkt-Performance und das Nutzerverhalten in der App. Daraus leitest du konkrete Empfehlungen ab, die bestimmen, was wir verkaufen und wie wir es verkaufen.
  • Kampagnen- & Partnerschafts-Analytics: Verwandle Kampagnen- und Kundendaten in echtes Wissen. Du bewertest den Erfolg von Marketingaktionen, damit unsere internen Teams und Markenpartner genau verstehen, was die Conversion antreibt.
  • Dashboard-Building: Erstelle und pflege automatisierte Reporting-Tools in Tableau oder Google Sheets, um dem Team einen Einblick auf unsere wichtigsten KPIs zu geben.
  • Optimierungsprojekte: Unterstütze bei der Umsetzung und Auswertung von Preisanpassungen, Sortiments-Updates und Promo-Aktionen, um den Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu maximieren. 
  • Abteilungsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Daten-Insights auch zu echten, nachhaltigen Verbesserungen führen.

Das bringst du

At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About the Role 

We're seeking a Principal Data Engineer who can work across the full stack of Anaplan’s data platform, setting the technical direction for how we ingest, transform, store, serve, and govern data at scale. You will build highly performant, robust data pipelines that process massive volumes of data in real-time and batch. This foundational work empowers business users to leverage vast datasets in their planning workflows and forms the bedrock for our advanced analytics and AI initiatives. You'll need deep knowledge of distributed computing, data architecture, and strong software engineering skills to tackle complex, high-scale data challenges.

Your Impact

  • Lead

CFGI Senior Managers lead project teams and interact with clients and their Big 4 auditors on all aspects of engagements, including report writing, developing and managing client relationships, and business development. listings.title: Senior Sales Executive - New Business
listings.description: About Smartnumbers We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams. What you'll be working on We're looking for someone to build out a long term 2–3 year strategic pipeline. As part of the role, you will be expected to do the following: Build and maintain a 12– 18 month active pipeline to support business objectives Build and maintain relevant market awareness through client discussions, market research and industry events Provide senior management with clear updates, progress and forecasts as evidenced through the company CRM Nurture the customer advocacy program in support of our broader business goals Prioritise activities to meet quarterly business targets while maintaining a longer-term strategic pipeline What you’ll achieve You’ll be helping us achieve our mission by enabling fraud investigators across organisations to collaborate in their fight against fraud using our SaaS platform. listings.title: Solutions Engineer - London or Remote
listings.description: Location: London or Remote Type: Full-time Level: Senior Reporting to: Solutions Lead About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. Every enterprise function, sales, customer support, HR, finance, is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there: millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents, but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer, is this working, and where, and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value, with no data ever leaving your environment. Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI, turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value. Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match. Why this role matters Winning enterprise deals is hard. Turning it into a long-term, expanding contract is harder, and that's where this role lives. You own the technical side of the customer journey, from first demo to expansion. listings.title: Lead Corporate Engineer
listings.description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose Our clinics depend on technology that simply works: the network, the devices and the rooms members walk into for their scan and debrief. As Lead Corporate Engineer in London, you’ll work alongside the Corporate Engineering team to provide industry-leading support services and build solutions. You’ll provide generalist support to the company at our London HQ and, on top of that, be Corporate Engineering’s domain expert for network and security, the key contact for our network and AV partners, and the person on site when a clinic opening or incident needs hands-on ownership. Over time, you’ll shape how we run our network as Neko scales, with member experience and long-term reliability as the test for every decision. What You’ll Deliver in the First 6-12 Months Own network incidents end to end across Cisco Meraki (MX/MS/MR), LAN/WAN, VPN and firewall as the primary contact for our network partner, reducing escalations to the wider team (Impact, not activity). Lead clinic-room readiness for new openings, coordinating AV vendors and Facilities and Clinic leads so Sonos, Soundtrack, Dante and debrief-room displays are tested and handed over on time (Member-first, always). Take delegated ownership of the network partner relationship and set out a long-term operating model for the network, making clear trade-offs on what Neko should own directly (Chase 10X, not 10%). Establish working coverage

We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. As a Mid-Market Account Manager at monday.com , you will drive revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing opportunities within the segment, helping customers optimise their workflows, increase productivity, and scale their operations. listings.title: Engineering Manager
listings.description: About Stora Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses. Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated. In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators. We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next. Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it. The Role This is a genuine people leadership role. You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing. Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves. This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision. You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora. What Else You’ll Own Engineering Management Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback. Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like. Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed. Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond. Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead. Performance & Progression

listings.title: Remote Sales Development Representative United Kingdom (m/f/d)
listings.description: About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️ Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in! We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️ Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. listings.title: Software Engineer
listings.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Kernel Software Engineer, you own the low-level software platform that sits between our hardware and the flight application on our ground control stations. You work across the Linux kernel, board support and a custom Android build, so that every control, display and data link works reliably in the field. You are the bridge between our hardware and application teams, taking a new product line from board bring-up to mass production. Responsibilities Bring up, configure and maintain the Linux kernel on our hardware, including device tree, drivers and security patches. Customize and maintain our Android build, covering system services, permissions, boot sequence and OTA updates. Integrate controls, display, touch, battery and radio modules, and expose them cleanly to the application layer. Ensure robust, low-latency SBUS and MAVLink data flows between the controller, the radio and the drone. Debug hardware and software issues alongside electronics and mechanical engineers, using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and UART/JTAG. Define flashing, provisioning, factory test and release procedures with the production team. Work with QGroundControl engineers and QA to validate system behavior on real hardware. Join field tests and flight sessions to validate your work in real conditions. Candidate Requirements Master’s degree in Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related field. 3+

listings.title: Fachärzt:in für Psychiatrie (a); 40-100%
listings.description: Warum Ovivamed? Bei Ovivamed verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern. Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Großbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschließlich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Komm zu uns und werde Teil des Teams, das diese Zukunft möglich macht! Die Stelle Als Fachärzt:in für Psychiatrie bei Ovivamed bist du Teil unseres interdisziplinären Chronic Care Teams. Du betreust Patient:innen mit Adipositas und begleitenden psychischen oder neurodivergenten Erkrankungen – sowohl online als auch vor Ort in Zürich oder Bern. Dabei gestaltest du moderne, digital gestützte Behandlungswege mit und setzt dich dafür ein, psychische Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt einer empathischen und respektvollen Versorgung zu stellen. Deine Aufgaben Psychiatrische Beurteilung und psychopharmakologische Führung unserer Patient:innen Durchführung von Diagnostik und Festlegung individueller Therapiepläne Durchführung ambulanter Psychotherapie (vor Ort und per Video) Fachärztliche Supervision der Psychotherapeut:innen, inkl. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure.
